hero.label: Made for Vulcan Technologies
hero.headline: I want to help Vulcan put AI into every legal team's hands.
hero.subheadline: Legal and regulatory teams are drowning in information they can't move fast enough on, and Vulcan is building the layer of AI that changes that. I've spent the last year doing BDR and digital marketing work in early-stage B2B environments, and this is exactly the kind of problem I want to be selling into. The combination of enterprise stakes, complex buyers, and genuinely novel technology is what gets me up early to make calls.

whyCompany.title: Vulcan is attacking a market that has resisted software for decades
whyCompany.body: Legal, regulatory, and policy teams have been notoriously slow to adopt technology, which means the window for a well-positioned AI product to become the default is wide open right now. Vulcan is going after enterprise buyers who have real budget and real pain, not just curiosity. That is the kind of market where a sharp SDR can create outsized pipeline.

whyCompany.title: Early SDR hires at companies like this define the sales playbook
whyCompany.body: Getting into a startup at this stage means the outreach sequences, the messaging, and the ICP targeting are still being figured out. That is not a risk to me, that is the opportunity. I want to be the person who helps build the foundation, not the person who inherits it two years from now.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this in complex B2B environments
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end to end using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped bring in 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, which taught me how to prospect when there is no brand recognition to lean on. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy selling to mission-driven organizations, which sharpened how I tailor messaging to buyers who care deeply about outcomes, not just features. Enterprise legal buyers are sophisticated and skeptical, and I know how to earn their attention.

quote: I am not looking for a BDR role where I dial through a list. I want to help build the pipeline for a company that is genuinely changing how institutions interact with the law, and I want to earn my way into that room.
